summary: A long established UAE firm appears to lose a little polish to visible page errors that clients see before they see the work.

findings.problem: An error message that reads ivory-search 404, search form does not exist, appears in the page near the menu.
findings.cost: Visible code errors on a premium firm site make clients doubt the details.
findings.fix: Fix or remove the broken search block.

findings.problem: Stray markup characters appear to show in the page text near the header and the end of the page.
findings.cost: Broken markup looks careless on a flagship firm site.

findings.problem: The newsletter consent appears to read Galadari Advocates & legal Consultants One Person LLC with a lowercase legal.
findings.cost: Small naming slips weaken a legal brand that sells on precision.

findings.problem: The page appears to offer a Contact Us path in the menu but no clear single enquiry button or booking option on the first screen.
findings.cost: Busy executives leave when the next step is not obvious.
findings.fix: One clear consultation button on the first screen.
